resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Idaho page header says Abandoned, but its history line and the other four sources say destroyed in 1950. The story uses 1950 destroyed.

The Clearwater forest place-name note calls the peak Cooperation Mountain and says the Lolo Forest built a lookout there for Warm Springs fires. Likely the same site as Cooperation Point, but the note does not name the lookout.

notes_for_editor: Built and destroyed years agree across all four lookout pages and lists; the Forest Service PDF text is scrambled in extraction, so its Cooperation row was read by hand. The link to the Lolo Forest rests on a place-name note that calls the peak Cooperation Mountain: probably this site, not proven. The record's coordinates (46.42684, -114.8209) were not checked against Sec 27 T36N R13E, 8 miles SW of Powell RS; a person should check the pin. No staffing or fire history was found in the sources, so none is written.
